category: crypto market data API (listings, quotes, metadata, global metrics, DEX data)

free_tier.stated: Basic plan, free: 15,000 monthly call credits at 50 requests per minute, 1 API key, 1 year of daily quote history; a keyless public API on a shared per-IP pool also exists
free_tier.notes: The keyed host is pro-api.coinmarketcap.com with the X-CMC_PRO_API_KEY header; the keyless root adds /public-api and serves 18 standard and 17 DEX endpoints. A keyless call answered HTTP 429 with error 1022 on its first request from a residential ISP address. Builder is the first paid plan at USD 29 a month billed yearly for 150,000 credits.

per_object_cap.notes: One currency conversion per call on Basic.

retention.notes: Basic reaches 1 year of daily quotes and 1 month of intraday; all-time history starts at the Startup plan.

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; credits per call bound what a Basic key can pull

interface_detail: GET https://pro-api.coinmarketcap.com/... with the key in the X-CMC_PRO_API_KEY header; GET https://pro-api.coinmarketcap.com/public-api/... with no key
tooling: curl or any HTTP client; official Python, JavaScript and Go SDKs, an MCP server and an OpenAPI file are published
chaining: A free key gives 15,000 credits a month of listings and quotes; CoinPaprika and CoinLore give keyless prices with no monthly key.

limits.value: 15,000 call credits per month on the Basic plan
50 requests per minute on the Basic plan, reset every 60 seconds
keyless public API: a shared IP-based rate pool, size not published; error 1022 once the anonymous limit is reached

limits_note: Bulk path: none on Basic; all-time history and OHLCV start on paid plans. Storage terms: unverified, the commercial terms page rendered as an empty shell.
binding_note: 15,000 credits a month, with more than 1 credit for larger responses, is spent before the 50 requests per minute matter.

identity_cost.detail: A Basic key needs a Developer Portal account: the sign-up form asks for Email, Name and Password and a plan choice; the vendor says no credit card. The keyless public API needs no account, but it answers 429 once its shared anonymous limit is reached.

reliability_note: Keyless calls share an IP pool and answered HTTP 429 (error 1022) on the first probe; keyed calls past the minute limit answer 429 and wait 60 seconds.
confidence_note: Plan numbers are read from the vendor pricing and guide pages; a keyless probe measured the 429. The key was not exercised.

evidence.quote: The current pricing page lists Basic as the free authenticated tier with 15,000 monthly call credits and 50 requests per minute.
